title: CharacterSet
description: A character set a board can draw. FiestaUI's src/lib/character-sets.ts is the source of truth (validateCharacterSet mirrors this schema); a FiestaBoard output plugin declares one of these in its manifest, optionally partial over `extends`, and FiestaUI materialises it.

extends.description: A built-in set id or another declared set; missing fields are inherited from it.

chars.description: Every printable character the set draws (single characters; blank is implicit).

glyphs.description: Bitmaps for characters in `chars` the face does not carry: glyphHeight rows of glyphWidth '#'/'.' characters.
